structural_finding.reason: The maker sizes many orders at approximately 25% of displayed bid touch before applying a queue-ahead multiple gate. For non-cash-binding orders this mechanically makes queue_ahead / own_shares approximately 4, so a max_queue_multiple=6 gate admits large dead queues even when observed post-entry compatible sell flow is zero. The forward-causal smoke therefore demonstrates that queue-multiple admission alone is not a fill-hazard model.
structural_finding.required_challenger: Gate or rank maker entry/reprice by causal compatible contra-flow hazard and edge-weighted fill probability; cancel/recycle dead queues; allow inside-spread improvement only when incremental price cost is paid by post-cost edge. Do not convert to taker solely to manufacture fills.
